profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One | ex-Google, ex-AWS | MBA from NYU Stern
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the design and implementation of a high-throughput distributed system capable of processing approximately 54 million events daily, leveraging a technology stack that included Apache Flink, Kafka, AWS SQS, and AWS Lambda.
• Guided a team of 5 engineers to develop a data pipeline, delivering auditable and analytical data for approximately 21 million events daily.
• Drive a customer-centric and product-focused approach within the organization to enhance platform health and overall performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technology Leadership · Systems Design

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer | Founding Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a customized ticketing platform for event organizers to enhance event participation.
• Created an affiliate marketing platform on Stripe, reducing payout wait time to minutes.
• Designed a central hub platform for fans to subscribe to artist updates, driving higher sales conversion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Enhanced Fuchsia OS upgrade tests with GoLang, saving $100K annually.
• Implemented log-stats Rust component for Google Nest Smart Display.
• Developed new test patterns for Fuchsia OS compatibility tests and automated UI tests for Nest devices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Developed a framework with Spock for function tests of AWS public pricing models, reducing development time for various teams.
• Researched and documented business requirements for AWS Reserved Instance pricing model for scalable design.
• Mentored an intern in developing an AWS QuickSight dashboard to provide valuable insights to leadership.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Guided a team of developers to enhance platform engagement through comments feature.
• Mentored CODA Associates to develop a web application using ReactJS, PostgreSQL, and Python Flask.
• Led migration of a web application to AWS ECS and ReactJS, improving performance and scalability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led re-architecture of web app, reducing infrastructure cost by 75% using AWS ECS, ALB, Docker.
• Implemented CICD Jenkins pipeline for automated code quality checks, security checks, and releases.
• Set up proactive monitoring with New Relic, Datadog, Fluentd, ELK.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed microservices using Docker and AWS ECS to enhance system scalability
• Designed Python Flask API for Elasticsearch cluster, improving website search functionality
• Implemented JWT authentication and Python Flask for enhanced web application security

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
• Incorporated collaborative learning in analytical physics classroom for students’ professional development.
• Helped peer students to understand the concepts of electromagnetism, optics and quantum physics.
• Worked along with the faculty members to improve the learning experience.
• Along with guiding peer students, also improved my knowledge in the field of physics.
• Developed new communication skills and group facilitation skills.

positions.title: Corporate Services- Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Gained better knowledge of insurance industry and studied company’s day-to-day operations.
• Implemented a program with the help of Java and SQL, which reduced report generation time by 75%.
• Operated in a datacenter, ensuring GFS strategy to prepare daily data backups.
• Devised a strategy to update the profiles for all the extension numbers of the company.
• Generated and updated the reports for company devices through MobileIron MDM.
• Worked on IBM AS400 mainframe and provided technical support throughout the office.
